runner_script:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,hashlib,shutil,os
root=Path('/workspace/averon-oreburgh-geography/Pokemon Game');engine=Path('/workspace/averon-frontier-runtime-20261026/Pokemon Game/engine');out=Path(__file__).parent
maps=['MAP_SINNOH_STARK_OUTSIDE','MAP_SINNOH_STARK_ROOM1','MAP_SINNOH_STARK_ROOM2_WEST','MAP_SINNOH_STARK_ROOM2_CENTER','MAP_SINNOH_STARK_ROOM2_EAST','MAP_SINNOH_STARK_ROOM3']
receipt=json.loads(Path('/workspace/averon-session-evidence/frontier74-main30-20261027/receipt.json').read_text());summaries=[]
for profile in ['normal','release']:
 for path,h in receipt['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((engine/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,path
 scratch=Path('/workspace/scratch')/('stark74-'+profile+'-20261027');scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/claude_play/map_qa.py'),'fixture-save','--engine',str(engine),'/workspace/averon-session-evidence/west-final-game-written-normal.sav',str(scratch/'game.sav'),maps[0],'14','8'],check=True)
 rom=engine/('pokeemerald-cries-off'+('-release' if profile=='release' else '')+'.gba');target=out/(profile+'-traversal')
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/claude_play/map_qa.py'),'run','--engine',str(engine),'--rom',str(rom),'--scratch',str(scratch),'--out',str(target),'--build',profile,'--save','stark74']
 for name in maps:cmd+=['--map',name]
 with (out/(profile+'-traversal.log')).open('w') as log:code=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
 result=json.loads((target/'result.json').read_text());summaries.append(dict(profile=profile,scope='traversal',code=code,verdict=result['verdict'],checks=len(result['checks'])))
 print(summaries[-1],flush=True)
 if code:continue
 saved=target/'saved-stark74.json';assert saved.is_file();fresh=Path('/workspace/scratch')/('stark74-continue-'+profile+'-20261027');fresh.mkdir(exist_ok=False);shutil.copyfile(scratch/'game.sav',fresh/'game.sav')
 expected=json.loads(saved.read_text());map_id=result['checks'][-1].get('at',[maps[-1]])[0]
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/claude_play/map_qa.py'),'run','--engine',str(engine),'--rom',str(rom),'--scratch',str(fresh),'--out',str(out/(profile+'-fresh-continue')),'--build',profile,'--map',map_id,'--expect',str(saved)]
 with (out/(profile+'-fresh-continue.log')).open('w') as log:code=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
 result=json.loads((out/(profile+'-fresh-continue/result.json')).read_text());summaries.append(dict(profile=profile,scope='fresh Continue',code=code,verdict=result['verdict'],checks=len(result['checks'])));print(summaries[-1],flush=True)
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summaries,indent=2)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(int(any(x['code'] or x['verdict']!='PASS' for x in summaries)))
limitations: Continue entry relocates a private game-written legacy flash fixture to Outside(14,8); this is DEV-only, not story reachability.
Route227/226 full traversal, Surf, bike/rail and rock-climb progression are not accepted by this test.

All original 33 full-scene static findings and the Route228 3/4 FAIL remain preserved in issues/evidence/frontier-seams-20261027/RESULTS.json. Zero findings for the selected six-map subset does not clear the full scene.
Temporary section217 aliases can display Route201; no permanent Stark origins are allocated.
Human audio, Delta, ordinary acquisition, natural respawn and production registration are not tested.

The existing native evidence is 322 unique Averon identities completed across split runs on this same engine tree, with original interruption and timeout retained; not an uninterrupted or unfiltered suite.
